about: The human neuro-endocrine system modelled as one looped matrice of causally dependent systems which rely on homeostasis to remain balanced. Neurology, endocrine function and cognition are inseparable: the hypothalamus reads dopamine expression across five dopaminergic pathways and converts it into control signals for the pituitary, its sub-delegate hub, which drives three hormone axes - thyroid (HPT), adrenal (HPA), gonadal (HPG). Every pathway is bidirectional: every link is a feedback loop.

nodes.name: NEURO
nodes.detail: The cognitive-neurological layer. Dopamine expression across the five dopaminergic pathways is the management signal the hypothalamus reads; neurology, endocrine function and cognition are one system, not three.

nodes.name: HYPOTHALAMUS
nodes.detail: The upstream controller. Converts dopaminergic expression into control signals for the anterior pituitary, and integrates feedback from every axis plant.

nodes.name: PITUITARY
nodes.detail: The sub-delegate hub. Relays hypothalamic control signals as axis drives: TSH to the thyroid, ACTH to the adrenal, gonadotropins to the gonadal plant.

nodes.name: THYROID
nodes.detail: HPT axis plant. TSH is the signal, T4 is the battery, T3 is the active compound. Sets metabolic rate for hormone processing, digestion and dopamine interaction - which is why thyroid stabilisation comes first in any cascade.

nodes.name: ADRENAL
nodes.detail: HPA axis plant. Answers ACTH with cortisol and the core hormones; vasopressin and cardiac stability ride on this axis. It is also the system's compensator of last resort.

nodes.name: GONADAL
nodes.detail: HPG axis plant. Gonadal signalling under hypothalamic-pituitary drive, with its own feedback to the controllers.

nodes.name: LIVER / KIDNEY
nodes.detail: The conversion site: peripheral T4 -> T3 conversion happens here, not in the thyroid itself. A loop is only as strong as its conversion step.

edges.signal: control signals via the infundibular stalk

pathways.name: hormonal axes - TSH, ACTH, gonadotropins and the core hormones
feedback - every plant reports back to the controllers
control - hypothalamic signals to the pituitary hub

decoupling.title: Why loops matter: decoupling
decoupling.body: The system holds homeostasis only while its loops stay closed. Decouple one node - a plant that stops answering, a feedback line that goes silent - and the controllers receive contradictory or absent reports, compensation is ordered from the wrong organ, and balance decays toward systemic failure. The failure is never local: in a looped matrice, every decoupling is a whole-system event.

intake_module.title: Every programmer's first love: coffee and chocolate
intake_module.coffee_pushes: adenosine A1/A2A antagonism -> PVN CRH/AVP up -> POMC -> ACTH peak 30-60 min -> cortisol; A2A-D2 heteromer disinhibition amplifying D2 signalling. Coffee pushes the HPA axis and sharpens the dopaminergic layer at once.
intake_module.chocolate_brakes: theobromine too weak at A1/A2A to push; FAAH inhibition prolonging anandamide/CB1 blunting of stress CRH; 11beta-HSD1 inhibition reducing cortisol regeneration; baseline ACTH neutral. Chocolate brakes the same axis coffee pushes.
intake_module.note: One pushes, one brakes, both land on the same looped system - which is why the morning ritual is a control-systems problem, not a habit.

sim_modes.name: Homeostasis
sim_modes.summary: Every loop closed. Drives are answered, feedback is heard, conversion keeps pace. This is the system doing the only job it has: staying in range.

sim_modes.name: Stressed - the coffee push
sim_modes.summary: Adenosine blockade lifts the brake: CRH and ACTH drive harder, the dopaminergic layer sharpens, the medulla surges. The loops still close - but everything runs hot, and conversion starts to lag the drive.

sim_modes.name: Decoupled - a loop breaks
sim_modes.summary: The conversion loop is cut (red X). T4 leaves the thyroid and never comes back as T3; the controllers, reading silence as shortage, order more drive from the wrong organ while the adrenal compensates. Balance decays - not at the break, but everywhere. In a looped system, no failure is local.
